item.title: Le Nouveau Maquis to open second location in Tucker, Cuevacía now open in Atlanta
item.description: Le Nouveau Maquis, a West African restaurant, is opening a second location in Tucker, while Cuevacía, a Northern Mexico-inspired restaurant, has opened in Midtown, and Heritage, a restaurant focusing on the cuisines of Black and brown people, is set to open in Summerhill. The post Le Nouveau Maquis to open second location in Tucker, Cuevacía now open in Atlanta appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Colon cancer is now the deadliest cancer for young adults
item.description: Colorectal cancer is now the leading cause of cancer deaths among people under 50 in the US, with deaths from colon and rectal cancers in the under-50 age group rising by 1.1% annually since 2005. The post Colon cancer is now the deadliest cancer for young adults appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: ‘It’s an assignment and not just an opportunity’: Morehouse hires new head football coach
item.description: Morehouse College introduced Brad Sherrod as their new head football coach, who will bring his 30-year coaching experience to the program and lead with integrity, enthusiasm, mental and physical toughness, caring and selfishness, and great effort. The post ‘It’s an assignment and not just an opportunity’: Morehouse hires new head football coach appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Pinterest search trends reveal parents’ push for offline and experience-rich parenting
item.description: Parents are increasingly shifting away from screen-based activities and towards real-world experiences, as evidenced by a surge in searches for screen-free activities, family traditions, and outdoor learning. The post Pinterest search trends reveal parents’ push for offline and experience-rich parenting appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: ‘We’ve got it all’: State of Fulton County is a big deal, says Pitts
item.description: Fulton County Chair Robb Pitts addressed the State of the County at The Eastern, discussing the county's triple-A credit rating, low unemployment rate, and progress in healthcare, human services, and mental health care services, while also addressing the recent FBI raid and potential ICE implications. The post ‘We’ve got it all’: State of Fulton County is a big deal, says Pitts appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: ‘Building a better tomorrow’: The Arena at Southlake arrives in March
item.description: The Arena at Southlake, a $117 million, 268,000-square-foot facility, is set to open in March 2026, providing a premier venue for concerts, sporting events, and community gatherings, as well as educational opportunities for students in Clayton County. The post ‘Building a better tomorrow’: The Arena at Southlake arrives in March appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Georgia’s gubernatorial candidates weigh in on the value of public forums
item.description: Democratic and Republican gubernatorial candidates in Georgia recently participated in public forums to discuss important issues such as education, small businesses, and property taxes, and to hear from voters. The post Georgia’s gubernatorial candidates weigh in on the value of public forums appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Ladies First: Meet the Mayors 2026
item.description: At the 3rd Annual "Meet the Mayors of Georgia" event, Riverdale Mayor Evelyn Wynn-Dixon, Warner Robins Mayor LaRhonda W. Patrick, and South Fulton Mayor Carmalitha Gumbs discussed topics ranging from local governance and data centers to small businesses and engaging younger generations in public service. The post Ladies First: Meet the Mayors 2026 appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: ‘Turn the page quickly’: Atlanta United looks to avoid 0-2 start in San Jose this weekend
item.description: Atlanta United manager Tata Martino and midfielder Alexey Miranchuk spoke to the media ahead of their game against the San Jose Earthquakes, emphasizing the need to be aggressive and improve on their build-up from the last game. The post ‘Turn the page quickly’: Atlanta United looks to avoid 0-2 start in San Jose this weekend appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Faith on the Frontline doc screens at Morehouse College
item.description: Morehouse College hosted the world premiere screening of "Faith on the Frontline," a documentary chronicling the NCC's 75 years of shared ecumenical witness for justice, peace, and moral leadership, featuring former Atlanta Mayor and United Nations Ambassador Andrew Young reflecting on the church's central role in the civil rights movement. The post Faith on the Frontline doc screens at Morehouse College appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.
